tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: color.bg.page. The page and the StickyBar. Light: the theme's tint (`--theme-page`); dark: navy-950 for every app.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: color.text.primary. All ink on background and card. Dark: the theme's near-white (`--theme-ink-dark`).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: color.bg.surface. Tiles, Popup, neutral buttons, the segmented tab track.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: color.bg.accent (`--theme-accent`). Current tab, default button. A fill only, always under primary-foreground.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: color.text.on-accent. Text on primary: 7.12:1 green, 5.54:1 coral.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hover fill of round icon buttons (Popup close, date picker).

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: color.text.muted. Second caption line, Popup subtitle, placeholders. On background or card only.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: color.border.subtle (`--theme-line`). Rare dividers. Pills never have a border.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: color.bg.field. Input, search and select fill: the page colour.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: color.border.field. The 2px border of fields and selects, 4.9:1 or more on field and card (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: color.outline.focus. 3px outline on :focus-visible.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: color.text.error and color.bg.danger. Field errors, Delete.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: color.text.on-danger: 5.2:1 light, 6.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: icon-accent
tokens.usage: color.icon.accent (`--theme-icon-accent`). Icons, dots and thin marks in the accent hue. Never text.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: A pressed Toggle (`--theme-selected`): the accent for Jerseys, sun for Vinyles.

tokens.name: selected-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on selected.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: color.bg.highlight. Count chip.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: color.bg.success. Total spent chip, Got it, every submit.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: color.bg.info. Wishlist count chip.

tokens.name: on-chip
tokens.usage: color.text.on-chip. Text on sun, mint and sky in every theme: 8.17, 6.60, 5.14:1.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: color.bg.overlay. Behind an open Popup.

tokens.name: shadow-color
tokens.usage: The 3px offset shadow: navy at 12% on light pages, black at 35% on dark ones.
